name: How do ceramic tile and natural marble compare for kitchen backsplashes?

mainEntity.name: How do ceramic tile and natural marble compare for kitchen backsplashes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tile and stone backsplashes are selected based on durability, maintenance requirements, and overall interior style. Ceramic and porcelain tiles offer excellent heat resistance, straightforward cleaning, and diverse design patterns with lower maintenance. Natural marble and natural stone tiles add distinctive luxury and depth, but they require periodic sealing to guard against grease splatters and acidic cooking spills. Experienced tile installers ensure proper wall backing, precise leveling, and clean grout lines so moisture cannot penetrate drywall behind cooking areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Porcelain and ceramic tiles are durable and easy to clean, while natural marble offers an upscale look but requires regular sealing against stains and acidic food splashes.
